channel.title: The Kimberley Echo - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Kimberley Echo (kimberleyecho.com.au)

item.title: Kimberley Traditional Owners seek role in managing Purnululu National Park
item.description: A petition to State Parliament has been launched by Traditional Owners of Purnululu National Park in the East Kimberley to seek a formal role in managing the World Heritage-listed area

item.title: Derby police charge man with several weapon offences
item.description: Derby police have charged a 26-year-old man with several weapons-related offences after allegedly discovering ammunition, parts of a firearm, drug paraphernalia and other weapons during a search of his home.

item.title: Aboriginal health leader Pat Turner retires after nearly a decade
item.description: Boards of Kimberley Aboriginal Medical and Kimberley Renal services acknowledge retirement of Pat Turner

item.title: Lake Argyle holding enough water to fill Optus Stadium 12,700 times causing Pannikin Bay closure
item.description: Lake Argyle is holding enough water to fill Optus Stadium almost 12,700 times following heavy rainfall across the East Kimberley resulting in the closure of Pannikin Bay.

item.title: Kununurra wins tourism gold
item.description: A unique outback dining experience in Kununurra has taken top honours on the national stage, winning two gold awards at the Qantas Australian Tourism Awards.

item.title: Theatre Kimberley youth program gets funding boost
item.description: Theatre Kimberley’s Youth Program receives Healthway grant from the State Government

item.title: Darrajayin declared first Aboriginal heritage protected area in WA in almost 30 years
item.description: Darrajayin on Malarngowem country in the East Kimberley has been declared the first Aboriginal heritage protected area in almost 30 years, granting the site the State’s highest cultural protections.

item.title: From the Kimberley to Darwin: rangers lead fire conversation
item.description: More than 50 Indigenous land and sea management representatives from across the Kimberley attend the 8th annual North Australian Savanna Fire and Carbon Forum and National Indigenous Carbon Forum

item.title: Warriors cement position at top of Kununurra Basketball Association standings before finals
item.description: The Warriors have cemented themselves at the top of the Kununurra Basketball Association senior men’s standings as the competition prepares to enter the finals next week.

item.title: Colours of the country
item.description: Colours of Country is a new celebration of East Kimberley culture coming to the Boab Metals Ord Valley Muster in May
